name: andrej-karpathy-skills
description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
one_liner: A single text file you drop into a project that nudges an AI coding assistant to stop guessing, stop over-engineering, and ask before it breaks things.
buyer: No real buyer — this is a free instructions file any individual developer copies into their own project; it's not something a business would purchase.
business_use_cases: N/A — this is a copy-paste configuration file, not a product with a delivery mechanism.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic — the value is entirely in the free text content itself; there's no service or packaging that would justify charging for it.

steal_this: Nothing to build — just read the four principles and paste an adapted version into your own CLAUDE.md.
